name: Portal UI parity — providers
summary: Foundry portal's '+ New connection' only creates AzureOpenAI/OpenAI/CognitiveSearch/AzureBlob/AppInsights/ApiKey/CustomKeys/GroundingWithBingSearch.
description: ApiManagement and ModelGateway connection categories are code-only (Bicep/CLI). Anthropic, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, and DeepSeek are reachable only through one of those two code-only categories. BYOM connections also do not appear in the Models+endpoints page or the Chat/Agents Playground dropdowns.
notes: Status-only — documents the UI surface gap.
